questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a conditional clause?
options: Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.
She would have left immediately, had she known the truth.
If she knew the truth, she would leave immediately.
She left immediately if she had known the truth.
questions.answer: Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly expresses the idea that ‘the most important factor in success is effort’?
options: It is effort that is the most important factor in success.
The most important factor in success is effort, it is.
What matters most in success is effort.
Effort is the factor; it is most important in success.
questions.answer: It is effort that is the most important factor in success.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood in a hypothetical context?
options: She wishes she go to Paris next year.
She wishes she **goes** to Paris next year.
She wishes she **went** to Paris next year.
She wishes she **had gone** to Paris next year.
questions.answer: She wishes she **went** to Paris next year.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates the use of ellipsis with a repeated phrase in a formal context?
options: He said he would do it, and he did it. He didn’t say he wouldn’t.
He said he would do it, and he did it. He didn’t say it wouldn’t.
He said he would do it, and he did it. He didn’t say anything about it not happening.
He said he would do it, and he did it. He didn’t mention it would fail.
questions.answer: He said he would do it, and he did it. He didn’t say it wouldn’t.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly combines two complex clauses using a formal and nuanced choice of conjunction?
options: Although the project was delayed, we managed to complete the report on time.
Despite the project being delayed, we managed to complete the report on time.
The project was delayed, so we managed to complete the report on time.
Because the project was delayed, we managed to complete the report on time.
questions.answer: Despite the project being delayed, we managed to complete the report on time.
